blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — At least 50 people have applied for Cabinet and other top-tier positions in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) headed by Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua. Macacua created a panel vetting the applicants for competence, integrity, and leadership as the first elected Bangsamoro Parliament gears up to fulfill its mandate until June 30, 2031. As of Monday, 22 of the applicants had been interviewed, Member of Parliament Naguib Sinarimbo, a member of the screening committee, said.
